title: Blooping Bobtail Squid
statement: Heralded by tiny, rhythmic puffs of bubbles as it hops across a twilight-blue sanctuary of velvety moss and slate arches, this thumb-sized cephalopod flashes shifting constellations of soft gold and cyan across its skin. Between blinking curious greetings at passing visitors, it meticulously arranges tumbled sea-glass and smooth pebbles into neat, glowing spirals along the sandy floor.
